claim_boundary: This record explains the already-failed Schefer holdouts. It does not alter the frozen primary result, fit parameters, or validate a hydrogen-refuelling station loop.

residual_pattern: The frozen adiabatic vessel model underpredicts the first measured peak by about 11.3%.
The predicted decay reaches half peak about 28.3% earlier than the digitized experiment, so increasing the aperture alone would worsen the timing error.

The published downstream tube and manifold inventory are outside the locked local-aperture claim; their omitted resistance/inventory and valve-opening dynamics are plausible contributors, but cannot be fitted from this holdout.
The initial pressure is reproduced, but the measured trace falls sharply during the first sub-second samples while the well-mixed model decays smoothly.
The half-pressure timing is close, yet the pointwise median error remains high, indicating an early valve/transient mismatch rather than a simple global time-scale error.
The evaluator does not model valve opening, line compressibility or measurement response; changing the vessel volume or restriction to fit this curve would violate the frozen transfer test.

next_model_requirement: A transferable release model needs an explicit valve-opening law and distributed supply-line inventory/resistance, validated on a new untouched campaign before any parameter fitting is considered.
